question: Has Mevi Oil been acquired by or merged with another company? Who owns Mevi Oil now?
markdown:
Aceitera Mevi Mexico (maker of Mevi avocado oil) has not been acquired or merged. It remains an independent, family-owned enterprise operating as part of the
⁠Mevi Avocado Group
, which was originally founded in 1974 by Don Javier Medina.
